roots.title: Nonsmooth Optimization
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Nonsmooth Optimization; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Nonsmooth Model Sources
children.top_down_role: Model architectures and structural regimes that generate nonsmooth optimization problems; analytic calculus, optimality theory, and complete solution algorithms are owned by later chapters.

children.title: Generalized Differential Geometry Calculus
children.top_down_role: Generalized first- and second-order differential objects, variational geometry, calculus principles, structured nonsmoothness, active manifolds, and desingularization geometry; optimization algorithms and stability theory appear only through interfaces.

children.title: Nonsmooth Optimality Certificate System
children.top_down_role: Navigation for exact and approximate first-order certificates, constrained multiplier systems, proximal stationarity measures, structure-dependent optimality, certificate comparisons, and failure regimes.

children.title: Convex Subgradient
children.top_down_role: Deterministic first-order methods for nonsmooth convex minimization, organized by oracle information, geometry, method family, certification, complexity regime, and failure boundary.

children.title: Convex Nonsmooth Model Methods
children.top_down_role: Oracle-based polyhedral model methods for finite-dimensional convex nonsmooth minimization, including cutting-plane, bundle, and level frameworks, their certificates, complexity regimes, computational realizations, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Composite Residual-Envelope Calculus
children.top_down_role: Navigation for proximal, composite-linearization, and operator-splitting residuals; their envelope interpretations; certificate families; geometric regimes; complexity families; and failure boundaries.

children.title: Smoothing-Penalty-Continuation Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Navigation for smooth approximation of nonsmooth models, penalty reformulations, complementarity smoothing, parameter paths, certificates, and associated failure boundaries.

children.title: Nonsmooth Equation Local-Model Calculus
children.top_down_role: Finite-dimensional nonsmooth equation representations, map structures, generalized linearizations, local regularity, Newton approximation families, local convergence mechanisms, equation merits, and root certificates. General variational-analysis foundations, full globalization algorithms, smoothing and interior methods, function-space theory, and general numerical linear algebra remain outside this chapter.

children.title: Semismooth Newton Active-Set Methods
children.top_down_role: Navigation for Newton-type solution of nonsmooth equations, complementarity systems, active-set formulations, and their function-space and PDE-facing realizations.

children.title: Sampled Computational Nonsmooth Analysis
children.top_down_role: Computational access to generalized first-order information for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, including sampled approximations, discrete gradients, approximate-stationarity certificates, oracle complexity, and numerical realization.

children.title: DC-Type Optimization
children.top_down_role: Structural navigation for finite-dimensional DC and quasi-DC models, their criticality concepts, algorithm families, convergence theory, computational certificates, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Deterministic Weakly Convex-Nonconvex Model Method Family
children.top_down_role: Deterministic local-model methods for weakly convex and broader nonsmooth nonconvex objectives, including stabilized bundle schemes, stationarity certificates, identification phenomena, and computational failure regimes.

children.title: Stochastic Weakly Convex Nonsmooth Methods
children.top_down_role: Stochastic first-order, model-based, proximal, and derivative-free methods whose analysis is organized by weak convexity and envelope-based stationarity.
